versions.changelog:
Initial release — unified document normalization and compliance scanning tool.

- Scans text/Markdown files for PII (email, mobile number, Chinese ID), secrets (GitHub/AWS/OpenAI tokens, private keys), and URL-embedded credentials in one pass.
- Normalizes encoding, BOM, line endings, and whitespace; can emit a clean, normalized copy.
- Outputs masked hit reports in human-readable or JSON formats; never exposes secrets in full.
- CLI tool with zero non-stdlib dependencies; supports --clean, --json, and --list-rules.
- Fully local/offline — no network, no API calls, no data uploads.
